'''Central Ayuma''' is a sub-continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[Nasuanian Sea]] and [[Tasa Bay]] to the south. [[South Ayuma]] to the west, the [[North Ayuma]] to the north, and the [[North Acrola]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|2,902,984|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 19th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 270,793,519 as of 1765, making it also the 9thth largest sub-continent by population.
